rows.claim: Unit 1046 fires on repeated edit-type blocks (A/B edits, edit/revert, write/revert cycles) with or without validation failures and without reads, and adds its activation to the ` looping` logit only, so edit cycles are named looping instead of productive or recovering.

Unit 1613 fires when identical failing tests or long failure chains dominate the window without reads, edits, pending polls or http retries, and adds its activation to the ` stalled` logit only, so repeated identical failures are named stalled instead of productive or recovering.

The ` productive` row gains the measured productive deficit plus reads-present minus repeated-failure directions (and the ` recovering` row a linear retry/poll/resolution term), so windows with investigation and no repeated identical failures are named productive instead of recovering.
